ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in mottling patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white mottling cluster in the upper-medial region of the left lobe; scattered punctate white pixel clusters distributed across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate 92-degree interior pixel angle and a vertical depth relative to the posterior margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations detected along the posterior boundary, localized predominantly on the medial portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex anterior sweep transitioning to a shallow S-curve on the posterior trailing edges, terminating in rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated circular high-intensity pixel clusters at the upper margin of the left lobe and individual circular clusters on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the left lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical notch/irregularity on the distal tip of the left lobe and non-uniform trailing edge serration patterns.
